security_justification.audit_integrity: Failed authentication can no longer name a non-credential target through subject, resource or the authorization resource context, which would record which account a failed login aimed at; the approved credential target stays accepted.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: The rule judges only the target type of authentication.failed; authentication evidence, actor and authorization checks are unchanged.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The SDK still cannot establish where a value came from; the rule refuses by type only and does not claim provenance.
security_justification.concurrency: A pure check over an already-normalized event; no shared state, ordering or concurrency is introduced.
security_justification.confidentiality: Refusal returns a fixed code, category and path; no subject, resource or caller value is echoed.
security_justification.cryptography: No algorithm, key, digest or keyed reference handling changes.
security_justification.error_disclosure: It reuses SDK_SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_FAILED with six fixed bounded paths (subject type and display name, resource type and parent type and id, authorization resource context type); no new code, message or value is disclosed.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The frozen contract and the collector's structural admission are unchanged; the Node error catalog gains one documented cause.
security_justification.fail_posture: Every shared path fails closed with zero sink calls; old events get no redelivery exemption.
security_justification.lifecycle: No operation, commit or lifecycle-phase rule changes; the check runs after every existing semantic check.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: One production source file, one new top-level test file and enumerated documentation; #861 changes no code.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No transformation hook or privacy policy changes; refusing account targets narrows what a failed login can disclose.
security_justification.resource_retention: No state, cache or retention is added; the policy is a module-scope constant.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: redeliver() refuses an old account-target event exactly as a new one; delivery mechanics are unchanged.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Claimed tenants remain refused on the original event and preserved only on the dedicated violation event (#861); failed-authentication targets are limited to the credential (#862).
